note: Philosophy program: bare-label sub-lessons rewritten as the claim each key point actually makes. Grounded in each book's own card text (see .tmpscripts/dump-cards.mjs output). Doc ids are stable; renameTopics re-keys questions/cards/guides.

renames.to: Innate talent is a myth: the future stars showed no early edge
Experience is not improvement: twenty years can be one year repeated

renames.from: Limits of IQ as a predictor
renames.to: High IQ does not predict high performance
Deliberate practice means drilling the weak link with constant feedback
Mastery has a ten-year on-ramp before the great work arrives
Eureka is built from deep immersion, not sudden inspiration
Your inner voice is a tool: it replays the past and rehearses the future
Chatter hijacks a spotlight that holds only three to five things
Chatter taxes your focus, exhausts your friends, and wears out your body
Distance quiets chatter: watch it as a fly on the wall
Using your own name instead of I turns threat into challenge
Nature restores the attention chatter drains, because awe is effortless
Emotions are a feature, not a bug: steer their intensity, do not erase them
Attention is a spotlight you can zoom, and brief avoidance is a real tool
Your senses shift emotion fastest, and bundling them multiplies the effect
Physical space is an emotional lever: switch rooms or reshape yours
Emotions are contagious, so choose deliberately whose you catch
WOOP closes the knowing-doing gap: wish, outcome, obstacle, if-then plan
You will miss out either way, so choose the few things worth caring about
Do not ask what you want, ask which struggle you are willing to sustain
Good values are real, useful to others, and within your own control
Comparison is rigged: Mustaine sold 25 million records and felt a failure
Take a hundred percent responsibility even for what you did not cause
Every obstacle turns on three disciplines in order: perception, action, will

renames.from: Obstacles as hidden pathways to success
renames.to: What stands in the way becomes the way

renames.from: Focusing on what you can control
renames.to: Your mind is the only thing you own, so build the inner citadel there
Events are neutral until you judge them: an eclipse is not an omen

renames.from: Present-moment focus over past and future worry
renames.to: Do not win the championship, win the single rep in front of you
